'''Michael Riboulet''' was runner-up at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]] and the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] (United Kingdom). He was the first player in two Grand Finals. Gary Carman later named him as a Bristol playtest partner.

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub. Facts below are from published SWCCG tournament sources. It does not add unsourced biography.

== Tournament results ==

* 2nd, [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]
* 2nd, [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]
